milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate to the magenta bed at relative position (4, 0, 3) and face it, modeling 'player can see the target'. Max distance of 5 blocks and 60-degree facing tolerance ensures the player has actually located and is looking at the bed.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a stone pickaxe results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 3 cobblestone and 2 sticks, and a crafting table is at (0, 0, 4) relative to spawn. The stone_pickaxe is not in the starting inventory so its presence confirms crafting.

Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind=block) because packed ice drops NOTHING without Silk Touch enchantment, making inventory_has impossible. Instead, we verify that at least one packed_ice block has been removed from the original cluster area. The cluster is at (5-7, 0, 2-3) with one at (6, 1, 2) relative to spawn. A generous box (±3) around the cluster center checks that at most 6 blocks remain (originally 7 placed), confirming at least 1 was mined.

Uses inventory_has because gray concrete drops itself when mined with any pickaxe. After the player crafts the stone pickaxe and mines a gray concrete block, the item appears in inventory. Gray concrete blocks are at (-4, 0, 2), (-4, 0, 3), (-3, 0, 2) relative to spawn.
